findings.title: No price behind the "no fee on top of the hire" claim

location.description: the opening paragraph and the routes list

findings.viewer_experience: The paragraph ends on "no fee on top of the hire", but the visitor has no number to check it against what an agency charges, so the page's one reason to book here is a claim taken on trust.

current.value: no price or starting price shown

findings.target: a starting price per route or per night is shown near the route lengths or under the paragraph
findings.fix_direction: Show a starting price per route or per night, near the route lengths or under the paragraph. The maker must supply the figure from their own price list.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic sees a price or starting price near the route lengths or under the paragraph, at every viewport

findings.title: A holiday sold with no picture, and the dead band where one would go

location.description: the empty band under "See boats and dates"

findings.viewer_experience: Nothing shows a boat or water, so the slow, quiet feel the name "Slowwater" promises never arrives, and the band reads as unplanned leftover space rather than rest.

current.value: no photo; empty band between the link and the routes list

findings.target: one real photo of the company's own boats or its stretch of canal in that band
findings.fix_direction: Place one real photo of the company's own boats or its stretch of canal in the band. A stock photo does not do the job. The maker must supply the photo.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic sees one photo of a boat or canal in the band under "See boats and dates" in the desktop, tablet and widescreen viewports

findings.title: The "See boats and dates" link leads where Search leads, without the visitor's choices

location.description: the "See boats and dates" link under the paragraph

findings.viewer_experience: The link does the same job as Search but without the visitor's choices, so it adds a second route to the same place.
findings.target: the link has a different job, or is removed
findings.fix_direction: Give it a different job, such as linking to the full list of boats, or remove it.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic sees the link with a different job, or no link, at every viewport

findings.title: 16 px body and 14 px form labels are only 2 px apart

location.description: the form labels (Base, Start date, Nights, Berths)

findings.viewer_experience: Two sizes 2 px apart read as a mistake rather than a step in the scale.
findings.target: labels at 16 px, or 14 px kept as the one small detail size with nothing else near it
findings.fix_direction: Set the labels at 16 px and keep them gray, or keep 14 px as the one small detail size and make sure nothing else sits near it.

closed_when.check: type_sizes in every viewport has no two sizes within 2 px of each other, or the form labels measure 16 px

findings.title: On the tablet the headline breaks into three short lines and the paragraph is narrow

location.description: the headline and paragraph column on the tablet

findings.viewer_experience: The headline runs 8 characters per line over three lines and the paragraph runs 24.1 characters per line, so the text column is cramped beside the form.

current.value: 8 characters per line (h1), 24.1 characters per line (p.lead)

findings.target: a wider text column at this size, or the form stacked under the text as on the phone
findings.fix_direction: Give the text column more width at this size, or stack the form under the text as the phone does.

closed_when.check: characters_per_line of h1 in the tablet viewport is more than 8 and of p.lead is more than 24.1

findings.title: The tablet has a blank lower quarter below the routes list

location.description: the empty area below the routes list on the tablet

findings.viewer_experience: The lower quarter of the page is blank, so the layout looks unfinished.

current.value: blank lower quarter of the page

findings.target: the lower quarter of the tablet page is no longer blank
findings.fix_direction: Stack the form under the text, or add the photo, to take up this space.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic sees no blank lower quarter below the routes list in the tablet viewport
